  h.id as hotel_id,
  h.name as hotel_name,
  h.telegram_chat_id,
  h.telegram_bot_token
FROM hotels h
WHERE h.is_active = true
  AND h.telegram_chat_id IS NOT NULL

parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(whatsapp_messages_received), 0) as whatsapp_messages,
  COALESCE(SUM(phone_calls_received), 0) as phone_calls,
  COALESCE(SUM(whatsapp_ai_handled + phone_ai_handled), 0) as ai_handled,
  COALESCE(SUM(whatsapp_human_handled + phone_human_handled), 0) as human_handled,
  COALESCE(SUM(total_handoffs), 0) as total_handoffs,
  COALESCE(AVG(whatsapp_avg_response_time_ms), 0)::integer as avg_response_time
FROM daily_statistics
WHERE hotel_id = '{{ $json.hotel_id }}'
  AND date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'

=SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(whatsapp_messages_received), 0) as whatsapp_messages,
  COALESCE(SUM(phone_calls_received), 0) as phone_calls,
  COALESCE(SUM(whatsapp_ai_handled + phone_ai_handled), 0) as ai_handled,
  COALESCE(SUM(whatsapp_human_handled + phone_human_handled), 0) as human_handled,
  COALESCE(SUM(total_handoffs), 0) as total_handoffs,
  COALESCE(SUM(handoffs_by_low_confidence), 0) as handoffs_confidence,
  COALESCE(SUM(handoffs_by_complex_request), 0) as handoffs_complex,
  COALESCE(SUM(handoffs_by_user_request), 0) as handoffs_user,
  COALESCE(SUM(handoffs_by_angry_customer), 0) as handoffs_angry,
  COALESCE(AVG(whatsapp_avg_response_time_ms), 0)::integer as avg_response_time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT date) as days_with_data
FROM daily_statistics
WHERE hotel_id = '{{ $json.hotel_id }}'
  AND date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
